description: The sanctions screening decision feeds vendor onboarding: its outcome lands at the fact pointer the onboarding rules read, and its resolution state is the sanctions-screening evidence. This declares the seam the packs previously bridged by hand-copied facts.

onboarding.description: Decide onboarding from the screening decision's outcome.

edges.description: clear or match lands at /vendor/sanctionsScreening/status, and the sanctions-screening evidence is present exactly when the screening decision resolved.
